name: Demo G7: Delete-Like Redline Receptacle
description: Exercise a delete-like redline operation using an explicit receptacle-like modeled family-instance target with strict type, visible-before, delete-effect, absence, and visual-gate evidence.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view, level, and receptacle family/type that can be safely placed and deleted.
If the model lacks a host-compatible receptacle type, keep this task out of the local live override until discovery finds one.
success_criteria: A disposable receptacle family instance id is created in the model.
The native create result returns family/type/name evidence matching the requested receptacle symbol.
The created receptacle id is visible in the pre-delete visible-element inventory.
Native delete dry-run and apply effect evidence include the created receptacle id.
The post-delete visible-element inventory no longer contains the receptacle id.
A deterministic delete visual gate artifact passes using before/after capture evidence.
failure_criteria: The receptacle is not created or is created as a different requested type.
The pre-delete visible-element inventory does not contain the created receptacle id.
Delete dry-run or apply omits the receptacle id from effect evidence.
The post-delete visible-element inventory still contains the receptacle id.
The delete visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
grader_notes: This task makes receptacles a first-class delete-like benchmark instead of relying only on the generic family-instance task.
Text-note or tag evidence must not satisfy this task; it requires modeled family-instance proof.
